title: Add left and right gradient background to the exhibition board
goal: uses linear-gradient to represent the direction and two color scales.
summary: exhibition board transitions from light green on the left to light yellow on the right, and the original text remains dark for easy reading.
tasks: Set the background image of .banner to a linear gradient, write the direction to right, #e6f4ee on the left and #fff2d5 on the right.

example.note: to bottom points to the end point, and the colors transition in the order listed.

hint: gradient as the value of background-image. After the direction, write the starting point color first, and then the ending color.
